# ocr-pipeline

> OCR pipeline core: decode PNM and PNG to grayscale, median, Otsu and deskew preprocessing, an injected OCR engine port and line assembly Python package `trysac-ocr-pipeline`, import name `ocr_pipeline`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
